title: Charlie Kirk Killing
summary: Tyler Robinson, accused of killing Charlie Kirk, has asked a judge to remove the potential death penalty from his case. The defense claims that Robinson hit his intended target and did not endanger others. The incident has drawn attention to the case. The defense's argument is that Robinson's actions were targeted and did not put others at risk. The case is ongoing.
summary_points: Tyler Robinson is accused of killing Charlie Kirk
Robinson has asked for the death penalty to be removed from his case
The defense claims Robinson hit his intended target
The defense argues that Robinson did not endanger others
